pyq_bad.why: wrong topic: Article 21 (life and personal liberty)

patterns: Most PYQs are one-line article identification: six freedoms / press freedom / speech = Article 19.
'Not a fundamental right' traps: right to property (deleted, 44th), right to strike, RTI not expressly an FR.
Citizens-only: a foreigner (British citizen) cannot claim freedom of trade/profession.
APPSC repeats: detained person keeps freedom of expression; 97th Amendment co-operative societies (19(1)(c), 43B, Part IXB).
App adds BNS/BNSS section numbers and case-law match items that go deeper than the PYQs.
